lines.text: One loop by hand. The robot drives at three point six meters per second, spinning at one. It wants four, spinning at three.
With d t, the loop time, at zero point zero two seconds, that asks for twenty meters per second squared of driving, and one hundred of spin.
Check one caps the spin change at eight.
Check two: we're speeding up, and the fastest wheel moves at three point nine six. There, the motors allow ten point four nine, not twenty.
Check three: ten point four nine and two point eight seven make ten point eight eight. That's over ten, so scale by zero point nine one nine.
The new command: three point seven nine meters per second, spinning at one point one five.
